title: Data Engineering & Pipelines
desc: We design and build the pipelines that move data from your operational systems into a reliable, governed platform — batch, real-time, and everything in between.

title: Cloud Data Platforms
desc: We implement and optimise cloud data warehouses — Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, and Redshift — selected and configured for your workload, team, and cost profile.

title: Data Governance & Quality
desc: We build the catalogue, lineage, quality rules, and ownership model that turns your data platform from a collection of tables into a trusted, governed asset.

title: Analytics & Business Intelligence
desc: We build the analytics platform and dashboards your teams actually use — with consistent metric definitions, self-serve capability, and data that everyone trusts.

title: Reporting & Visualisation
desc: We design and build reporting systems that deliver the right numbers to the right people automatically — scheduled, governed, and presented in a format decision-makers can use.

title: Data Strategy Consulting
desc: We work with CDOs and data leadership to define where data creates the most business value — and build a funded, sequenced roadmap to get there.
